_about: Dated claims in the guides that go stale. One row per claim: page slug, the claim as the page states it, the source to re-check, and the date to re-check by (YYYY-MM-DD). .github/workflows/freshness.yml opens one GitHub issue listing every row past its date (1st of each month, or run by hand). Generated by _tools/build-site.py from the "freshness" rows in each guide's meta.json (_tools/articles/<slug>/ or _tools/handmade/<slug>/). After re-checking: update the page (sources, then assemble.py + check-all.sh), then move review_by forward or delete the row in that meta.json and run build-site.py.
